research_rationale: The full official EO 12159 extract contains three operative numbered provisions: establishment and member disqualification, an investigation report requirement, and a condition-preservation period tied to actual report submission. The machine draft wrongly starts within the dispute recital and merges 1-102 with 1-103; the candidate removes recital material and separates the three actual provisions while retaining exact held OCR. Section 1-102 is a deadline, not proof that a report was submitted. Section 1-103 lasts from the order date through 30 days after the actual report and permits changes by agreement, so the reporting/settlement history is material to earliest cessation. No actual report or submission record was found in held sources; prior queue line 44 requests it without a concrete URL. The full EO 12379 section 6 formally revokes EO 12159 on August 17, 1982 without a delayed date or express savings. That cleanup is recorded as a later event, not as the earlier finite duties' first end. Reused 1982 text attached by the machine chain to unrelated actor IDs and earlier dates is rejected. Strong original-text custody is established by the held official extracts and matching GPO PDF hashes without claiming image inspection. Provisional no is unchanged and the lifecycle stays partial pending actual report and agreement/extension evidence.
unresolved_material_gaps: ACTUAL_REPORT_NOT_HELD: section 1-102 requires a report within 30 days of September 20, 1979, but no held source establishes the actual report submission date, extension, completed investigation, or termination of board service. The deadline is not evidence of performance.

REPORT_DEPENDENT_END: section 1-103 extends the statutory no-change period for 30 days after the actual report, with changes allowed by agreement. Without the report and relevant agreement/extension record, neither its first end nor the last clause end can be dated. September 20 plus 60 days and August 17, 1982 cleanup are not substitutes.

RESIDUALS_AND_COUNTEREVIDENCE: the complete original and formal revoker have no express independent post-termination directive or saving, but completion/settlement records are absent. Numbered-EO catalog and saved-text searches identify formal revocation only and do not establish the actual board report or agreement-sensitive sequence; those missing actual events prevent closure of savings and bounded counterevidence.
